basic_details.job_title: RSJA Research Scholar Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline

application_fee.details: Every candidate shall pay Rs. 100/- as fee through Demand Draft or Postal Order to be drawn in the name of Director, Rajasthan State Judicial Academy, Academy.

age_limit.details: Maximum age of the candidate as on 1st January of year 2026 must not be more than 33 years.

qualification.details: A candidate must be a citizen of India.

salary_details.details: A fixed honorarium of Rs. 50,000/- per month without any dearness or other allowance/perquisite, shall be paid to the Research Scholar.

selection_process: The selection process comprises shortlisting of applications based on research achievements
followed by an interview by the Selection Committee assessing research/academic record as well as language communication and computer skills.
Shortlisting of the applications may be done on the basis of research achievements
academic career and computer skills of incumbents.
The Selection Committee shall assess the suitability of applicants after interviewing the candidates
considering their research/academic record as well as language communication and computer skills.
how_to_apply: Download the application form and terms and conditions from the official website http://rsja.rajasthan.gov.in.
Affix a latest colored photograph taken on or after 01.01.2026 in passport size with your signature thereon and self-attested across the mid of the photograph extending towards right side.
Mark the envelope containing application as "APPLICATION FOR ENGAGEMENT AS RESEARCH SCHOLAR".
Attach self-attested copies of certificates in support of age, educational qualifications, academic/research work/publications, and communication skills/working knowledge of computer.
Enclose Demand Draft or Postal Order of Rs. 100/- issued in the name of Director, Rajasthan State Judicial Academy, Jodhpur.
Furnish a checklist along with application form mentioning details about certificates and testimonials enclosed.

Send the application via speed post, registered post A.D., through courier, or deposit it by hand during office hours to the office of Director, Rajasthan State Judicial Academy, Jodhpur on or before 31/10/2026 (Latest by 05:00 PM).
important_instructions: The engagement is purely temporary on a contractual basis initially for a term of two years, extendable for a further period of one year based on performance. Research Scholar shall not practice in any court of law nor be engaged/appointed elsewhere on honorarium/payment or otherwise during the engagement. If already enrolled with any Bar Council, the candidate shall get his/her enrolment suspended during the entire term of this engagement. A Research Scholar intending to leave engagement at premature stage shall be required to give prior notice of three months, or residuary term of engagement, whichever is less. Research Scholar shall not leave headquarter without seeking permission from Director, Rajasthan State Judicial Academy, Jodhpur. Proportionate reduction of honorarium shall be made for unauthorized absence, so also for absence beyond permissible period of leave. The selected candidate will be given a 'Letter of Offer' on the date of commencement of engagement. Candidates must furnish names and contact details of two responsible persons of integrity, honesty and good moral character (not blood relations or other relatives) in column 21 of the application format.
